VIVA SUA BELEZA e venha trabalhar conosco! Te convidamos a avaliar essa oportunidade:


Auxiliar de Loja - Shopping Campo Grande | (Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência)


Endereço: Av. Afonso Pena, 4909 - Santa Fé, Campo Grande - MS,


O que estamos buscando?

Procuramos profissionais com conhecimento em produtos e serviços, além de habilidades sólidas em organização e gestão de tarefas, para colaborar com a equipe de loja.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Profissional que será o responsável pela organização do estoque da loja;

  • É responsável por cumprir com as políticas, regras e normas de Segurança do Trabalho e Saúde ocupacional de seu local ou processo de trabalho.

  • Ensino médio completo.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Suporte ao cliente
description:
Descrição da Empresa O Portal das Apostas é referência em soluções eficazes e sustentáveis para a indústria de apostas e entretenimento. Nosso compromisso é proteger pessoas, jogadores e parceiros, garantindo experiências personalizadas.


Salário: R$4500 + Benefícios.

Tipo de contrato: CLT - Remoto

Jornada: 08:20h Diárias

Escala: 5x2


Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um profissional para o cargo de Suporte ao Cliente, responsável por oferecer suporte técnico e assistência a nossos clientes para garantir sua satisfação e fidelização. As responsabilidades incluem responder a dúvidas, resolver problemas técnicos e fornecer orientações claras e eficientes. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e será realizado de maneira remota.

Qualificações

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Experiência em suporte ao cliente e foco na satisfação do cliente, garantindo um atendimento excelente e personalizado.
  • Habilidades Interpessoais: Competências para construir relacionamentos positivos, com capacidade de comunicação clara e empática.
  • Suporte Técnico: Conhecimento na resolução de problemas técnicos e disponibilidade para oferecer soluções rápidas e eficazes.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar e interpretar dados ou situações para tomar decisões fundamentadas.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em posições similares, conhecimento na área de apostas ou entretenimento e fluência em idiomas adicionais.

title: Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: SQL Architect

Location : Remote


15+ years of IT experience and minimum of 10+ years using public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL IaaS/PaaS, Azure Storage , Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM

Primary skills:

  • Demonstrates a high level of proficiency and hands-on expertise in delivering high quality designs using Architecture frameworks
  • Conducting AS-IS assessments of applications, designing target state architecture, and obtaining approvals from client architecture review board.
  • Expertise in On-prem/Public cloud Infra assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Driving the cloud Solutioning Azure activities for large complex migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering Business, Application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)

  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure & Windows environments (Processor, networking, clusters, IO, memory etc. related issues)

Secondary Skills:

  • Design infrastructure/Data storage solutions
  • Design business continuity/DR solutions
  • Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).


  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.


  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.


  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.


  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.


  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL, SOSL.


  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.


  • Knowledge of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and governor limits.


  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).


  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).


  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

title: Arquiteto de nuvem
description:
O Cloud Architect será responsável por conduzir avaliações técnicas, definir estratégias de migração, criar arquiteturas alvo e liderar a execução do plano proposto. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo alinhamento com padrões de arquitetura, governança e boas práticas da AWS.


Responsabilidades Principais:

-Realizar assessment dos ambientes atuais (discovery, análise de workloads, recomendações).

-Elaborar diagramas de arquitetura, planos de migração e cronogramas detalhados.

-Definir estratégias de migração considerando segurança, performance e custo.

-Apoiar na execução do plano de migração (delivery), garantindo aderência às recomendações.

-Utilizar ferramentas de apoio à migração (ex.: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, entre outras).

-Implementar práticas de monitoramento e otimização de performance pós-migração.

-Garantir conformidade com boas práticas da AWS e padrões corporativos.

-Interagir com stakeholders e apresentar relatórios técnicos.


Competências Técnicas:

-Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS Cloud (assessment e delivery).

-Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de soluções AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, etc.).

-Familiaridade com ambientes on-premises (virtualização, redes, storage).

-Domínio de ferramentas de migração e discovery (ex: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, AWS Application Migration Service).

-Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de performance (CloudWatch, Dynatrace, etc.).

-Capacidade de criar diagramas técnicos (Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart).

-Inglês fluente.


Perfil comportamental:

-Pensamento analítico e visão estratégica.

-Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma.

-Comunicação clara e habilidade para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

-Orientação para resultados e foco em qualidade.

-Flexibilidade para lidar com ambientes complexos e mudanças de escopo.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET + Kubernetes + AI Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns


What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.
  • Design, build, and support microservices that are scalable, resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
  • Work across MySQL, Redshift, and Valkey (Redis) to support both transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Deploy and operate services in Kubernetes on AWS.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows in Azure DevOps .
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with a strong emphasis on unit testing and automated testing culture (TDD).
  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and AI teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Use AI-powered tools for code acceleration, debugging, test generation, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Contribute to shaping long-term system architecture with a path toward becoming a Solutions Architect / Principal Engineer .


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong backend experience with .NET / C# , and comfort with modern runtime features.
  • Experience with .NET Core , Entity Framework , and cloud-native backend development.
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture , distributed system patterns, and clean coding principles.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and testable architecture.
  • If candidates cannot demonstrate real unit testing experience or passion, this role is not a good match.
  • Skilled in debugging, profiling, and optimizing backend systems.
  • Fluent English, comfortable with daily video-based communication.
  • Ability to work a full U.S. Pacific Time schedule.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Redshift or other analytical database systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS native services (SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
  • Experience with high-scale SaaS, data-heavy systems, or AI/ML integrations.
  • Experience with domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven patterns, or CQRS.


Who You Are

  • A self-motivated engineer with a passion for modern backend engineering.
  • Someone who enjoys working with the latest technologies , not legacy stacks.
  • A team player who cares about quality, testing, architecture, and long-term impact.
  • A builder who wants to grow into an architect and drive technical excellence.
  • A problem solver who takes ownership and thinks beyond task-level execution.
  • A strong believer in AI-accelerated development and continuous improvement.


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building high-scale backend systems from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to define architectural foundations, build mission-critical services, and grow into a senior technical leader. Our stack gives you the chance to work with cutting-edge .NET technology, real cloud scale, and ambitious product challenges.

If you’re passionate about backend engineering, love modern .NET, and want to become a future architect, we’d love to talk.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer (Remote | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

EST USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position

Duration: 6-12 months


Role Overview

We are seeking a AWS Cloud Automation Engineer to support the Database Engineering team. This is a hands-on, engineering-focused role centered on CI/CD automation , cloud database deployment, Terraform development , and acting as a technical escalation point.

This is not an operational/runbook role — the engineer must think architecturally, troubleshoot independently, and collaborate across multiple internal teams.

Core Responsibilities


Terraform Development

• Write, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform configurations

• Manage state, resolve drift, and support hybrid cloud deployments

• Contribute to new IaC standards and patterns

CI/CD Pipeline Engineering

• Build and troubleshoot Jenkins pipelines

• Support migration to GitHub and GitHub Actions

• Diagnose failures and implement durable fixes

Cloud Database Automation (AWS-focused)

• Automate database provisioning (Aurora, RDS, etc.)

• Work within evolving cloud automation frameworks

• Partner with architecture and delivery teams

Repository & Code Management

• Manage Bitbucket → GitHub migration

• Maintain version control best practices

• Contribute clear documentation and standards

Cross-Team Collaboration

• Work directly with:

o Database Engineering

o Architecture

o Delivery & Business Partners

• Serve as escalation for automation issues

• Share knowledge and support junior team members

Documentation & Communication

• Produce clean, detailed technical documentation

• Communicate clearly across all levels of the organization

Required Technical Skills

Must-Have

• Solid experience in DevOps/Cloud Engineering

• Strong hands-on experience with:

o Terraform (writing/developing, not just applying)

o Jenkins (build, modify, troubleshoot pipelines)

o AWS automation and deployments

• Troubleshooting CI/CD failures and infrastructure inconsistencies

• Git/Bitbucket repository management

Nice-to-Have

• GitHub & GitHub Actions

• GCP exposure

• Cloud database experience (Aurora, RDS, SQL Server, Postgres)

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong focus on GoLang to join a cross-functional, solution-driven development team. You will play a key role in building new products, developing integrations, and continuously evolving our platform. If you enjoy building scalable services, writing clean and high-quality code, and working in a collaborative, impact-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate within a cross-functional team to design and deliver product-driven solutions;
  • Develop and implement new features, products, and platform integrations;
  • Build scalable, resilient web services and APIs using GoLang;
  • Maintain high-quality standards through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices;
  • Identify and fix bugs while monitoring and optimizing application performance;
  • Contribute to aligning technical strategy with business objectives;
  • Produce clear and well-structured technical documentation;
  • Embody the team's values: ownership, innovation, collaboration, and customer empathy.


Technical Requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience;
  • Strong hands-on experience with GoLang for backend development;
  • Experience building scalable and fault-tolerant web services and APIs;
  • Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases;
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services;
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Concourse or similar);
  • Strong understanding of clean, testable, and maintainable code principles;
  • Experience with automated testing (unit and/or integration tests);
  • Strong communication skills to understand requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions;
  • Growth mindset: commitment to continuous improvement, proactive attitude, and strong sense of ownership.


What to Expect in the Day-to-Day

The role involves a balanced mix of:

  • New feature implementation;
  • Testing and validation;
  • Bug fixing and performance improvements;
  • Technical documentation.


Come and join the BEST IT TEAM!

title: Executivo(a) de Contas
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Executivo(a) de Contas Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Executivo(a) de Contas . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Disponibilidade para idas pontuais ao escritório e visitas a clientes, caso seja do RJ ou SP;
  • Experiência no setor de Utilities & Energia ;
  • Sólida experiência em vendas diretas consultivas, com histórico comprovado na prospecção de novos clientes e no posicionamento de ofertas de transformação digital;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações, desenvolvimento de software, automação de processos, serviços de AMS (Application Management Services), alocação de profissionais e licenciamento de software;
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas de serviços de TI, com histórico consistente de abertura de novos clientes e sólida atuação na gestão de contas da base instalada, com foco em relacionamento, crescimento e superação de metas;
  • Perfil hunter, com mentalidade empreendedora, alta energia e resiliência;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação executiva e negociação em contas enterprise;
  • Conhecimento prático sobre propostas de valor em transformação digital, abrangendo projetos, AMS, sustentação, alocação de profissionais e licenciamento de software;
  • Experiência no uso de CRM (preferencialmente Microsoft Dynamics) para gestão de pipeline, forecast e controle de vendas;
  • Habilidade em storytelling e construção de business cases;
  • Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado desejável, para atuação em oportunidades com fabricantes e parceiros.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar novas contas, identificando e acessando decisores em empresas enterprise por meio de abordagem consultiva e rede de relacionamentos;
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas, desde o primeiro contato até a negociação final e fechamento do contrato;
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com executivos de negócios e tecnologia, atuando como parceiro de transformação digital;
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas de valor, business cases e apresentações executivas personalizadas às necessidades do cliente;
  • Conduzir negociações com foco em geração de valor, margem e sustentabilidade do relacionamento;
  • Coordenar a transição para as equipes de entrega, garantindo o onboarding adequado de novos clientes;
  • Atualizar e gerenciar o pipeline no CRM, mantendo dados de oportunidades, previsões e atividades de vendas;
  • Monitorar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e propondo estratégias de diferenciação para a Sys Manager;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de pré-vendas, marketing e Centros de Excelência (CoEs) na estruturação de propostas competitivas e de alto valor.

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Engineering Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $8,500 - $10,000 USD


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure role is designed to own the technical systems responsible for money movement across their organization. At our partner, payments are not a support function. They are core product infrastructure. They advance funds to lab clients based on AI-driven claim valuation, reconcile against real insurance adjudication data, and manage complex settlement flows that must balance to the penny.


As transaction volume scales into hundreds of millions annually, the complexity of reliability, reconciliation, auditability, and compliance increases materially. This role exists to ensure they scale financial infrastructure with rigor, precision, and long-term architectural clarity. This is a player-coach leadership role, initially hands-on, evolving into team leadership and architectural stewardship of a dedicated payments engineering pod.


This role is accountable for:

  • Technical ownership of payment infrastructure and settlement systems
  • Reliability and correctness of all financial flows
  • Ledger and reconciliation architecture
  • Cross-team coordination for finance-critical systems
  • Building and leading a dedicated payments engineering pod


Key Responsibilities:


Payment Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own systems that disburse client advances, execute Treasury sweeps, process lockbox deposits, and generate settlement payments
  • Ensure all transactions reconcile precisely and remain fully auditable
  • Implement idempotency, monitoring, alerting, retry logic, and failure handling for payment-critical flows
  • Design workflows resilient to bank outages, ACH return codes, NSF events, and timing mismatches
  • Establish zero-error tolerance standards as volume scales


Ledger & Reconciliation Architecture

  • Design and evolve the internal ledger system tracking each receivable lifecycle from claim valuation to advance to adjudication to sweep to final settlement
  • Build reconciliation engines matching Payment Advances to ERA data
  • Automate weekly settlement calculations, including true-ups, clawbacks, and offsets
  • Ensure economic logic for Qualified vs. Non-Qualified claims is correctly implemented
  • Maintain strict auditability and financial traceability across systems


Cross-Team Collaboration & Platform Integration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Data, Billing, and Clinical Platform teams
  • Ensure payment systems integrate cleanly with claim processing, ERA ingestion, and AI valuation systems
  • Partner with the Data team on financial reporting, reconciliation validation, and KPI consistency
  • Align with shared infrastructure standards including observability, deployment, security, and API governance
  • Actively participate in architecture discussions to prevent payment systems from becoming isolated silos


Payment infrastructure must operate as part of the broader platform, not adjacent to it.


Banking & Financial Partner Integration

  • Own integrations with banking partners and payment rails including ACH, EFT, and lockbox flows
  • Ensure client onboarding for Treasury Accounts and payment configuration is scalable and repeatable
  • Evaluate and integrate banking-as-a-service platforms and financial data providers
  • Maintain compliance with NACHA rules, treasury controls, and internal financial policies


Team Leadership & Engineering Standards

  • Hire and build a payments-focused engineering pod consisting of 2 to 3 engineers within 12 to 18 months
  • Define engineering standards for reliability, testing, deployment, and incident response
  • Establish operational playbooks for payment-critical systems
  • Partner closely with Payment Operations to ensure systems support real-world workflows
  • Balance hands-on contribution with leadership and long-term architectural planning


What This Role Is Not:

  • Not a purely operational finance role
  • Not a detached architecture-only leadership position
  • Not a payments API integration wrapper role


This is a systems-level ownership role where financial correctness, reliability, and architectural clarity are primary responsibilities.


What Success Looks Like:

  • All money movement is reliable, traceable, and auditable
  • Settlement logic is automated and predictable
  • Reconciliation discrepancies are rare and surfaced early
  • Banking integrations are standardized and repeatable
  • Payment-critical incidents decrease over time
  • Cross-team dependencies are clear and well-managed
  • A high-performing payments pod operates with strong engineering discipline


Ideal Background:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • 3+ years building payment systems, financial infrastructure, or money movement platforms
  • Deep knowledge of ACH including NACHA rules, R-codes, batch construction, and prefunding
  • Experience designing ledger systems or reconciliation engines
  • Strong backend engineering experience including Python, Go, Java, or similar
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience operating payment-critical systems in production
  • Prior experience hiring or leading small engineering teams
  • Prior experience working at Nubank or in similar fintech companies


Strengths We Value:

  • Precision and rigor in financial system design
  • Systems thinking across multi-party money flows
  • Strong reliability mindset including observability, incident response, and recovery design
  • Clear, structured communication across engineering and finance stakeholders
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity while building durable architecture
  • High ownership and accountability


Why This Role Matters:

At our partner, money movement is core infrastructure, not an auxiliary capability.


Every advance, sweep, settlement, and reconciliation must be correct. As they scale into

hundreds of millions in annual volume, small architectural weaknesses compound into material financial risk.


This role ensures:

  • They scale financial infrastructure responsibly
  • They maintain trust with lab clients and banking partners
  • They prevent operational fragility as complexity grows
  • They build a durable foundation for future financial products


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure will help ensure that as they grow, their financial systems remain precise, resilient, and strategically aligned with the broader platform.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking


Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.


In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.


Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.


Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.


What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.

Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Agilista Sênior
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar no modelo 100% remoto, integrando o time de Tecnologia, com atuação estratégica e operacional, apoiando múltiplos times na evolução contínua das práticas, na melhoria do fluxo de trabalho e na geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Implementar e escalar o método Kanban em diferentes áreas da empresa, respeitando o contexto e maturidade de cada equipe;
  • Construir e facilitar workshops, treinamentos e sessões práticas sobre Kanban, fluxo contínuo, métricas e melhoria evolutiva;
  • Apoiar líderes e Product Owners na gestão de fluxo, políticas explícitas, limites de WIP e cadência de reuniões;
  • Monitorar e analisar métricas como lead time, throughput, aging e CFD para orientar decisões e melhorias;
  • Atuar como mentor de times ágeis, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e foco em entrega de valor;
  • Conduzir assessments de maturidade e planos de evolução baseados em práticas Lean e Kanban.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Experiência como Scrum Master, Agile Master e/ou Service Delivery Manager atuando com mais de um time simultaneamente;
  • Experiência como Agile Coach, Kanban Coach e/ou Enterprise Agile Coach;
  • Experiência comprovada com o Método Kanban;
  • Experiência prática com Flight Levels;
  • Experiência e domínio de métricas ágeis: lead time, cycle time, throughput, simulação de Monte Carlo, CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram) e histograma;
  • Experiência na facilitação de treinamentos, workshops, mentorias e cadências/ritos ágeis;
  • Experiência com técnicas e dinâmicas de Product Discovery, Design Thinking, Lean Inception e construção de MVP;
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em ServiceNow, Jira e Azure DevOps;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de métricas como Nave, Power BI e Actionable Agile;
  • Certificações obrigatórias: KMP (KSD + KSI), KCP (KMM + KCP) e FLSA;


Seria muito legal se você tivesse:


  • Certificação em F4P.


Informações adicionais:

Local de Trabalho: Brasil |Remoto.

Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:

  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.
  • Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! ️
  • Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: Recepcionista
description:
INCB-INSTITUDO DE NEUROCIÊNCIAS DE BRASÍLIA - Clínica de Saúde Mental


1- Vaga para: Recepcionista/Secretária

Requisito: Experiência em Clínicas na área de Saúde Mental ou área Médica     


2- Perfil Profissional: 

  - Organização e atenção aos detalhes: Fundamental para lidar agendamentos de pacientes, emissão de Notas Fiscais, responder demandas de WhatsApp e telefone;

 - Discrição e ética: Essencial, por se tratar de um ambiente de saúde mental, onde a confidencialidade dos dados dos pacientes é primordial. A candidata deve ter um perfil discreto e amigável e respeitar o sigilo profissional;

- Proatividade: A capacidade de antecipar necessidades e buscar soluções por conta própria será muito valorizada;

 - Boa comunicação: Habilidade para interagir de forma clara e respeitosa com a equipe, com os colaboradores e especialmente com os pacientes;

 - Capacidade de aprendizado rápido: Disposição para absorver novas rotinas e processos específicos da clínica.


3- Carga Horária, Remuneração e Benefícios:

 . Carga Horária: 44 horas semanais;

 . Remuneração: R$ 2.500,00;

 . Benefício:

  - Vale Alimentação: R$ 570,00

- Auxílio-transporte

  - Plano de Saúde (após o período de experiência)

  - Programa de premiação mensal por desempenho
company: INCB - Instituto de Neurociências de Brasília

title: Analista de negócios sênior
description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento do sistema ArcGIS;
  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;
  • Conhecimento de DevOps;
  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Interpretar documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes.
  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes de alta complexidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar as opções da plataforma ESRI que melhor atendam uma respectiva solução.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas SAP MM Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.


Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter endpoints REST utilizando FastAPI
  • Construir dashboards interativos usando React, Material UI e HighCharts
  • Consumir APIs e gerenciar estados complexos com React Query
  • Criar testes unitários e apoiar o processo de CI/CD
  • Validar dados e comportamento da UI junto às equipes de negócio e dados


O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado para comunicação (Será testado)
  • Python e FastAPI
  • React e TypeScript
  • Snowflake ou Databricks
  • CI/CD


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: Remote Senior Java Developer
description:
Required Skills & Experience:

- 5 to 10 years of experience as a backend engineer within a Java environment

- Java version 17 and above

- GCP experience (will consider Multi Cloud experience - AWS, Azure)

- Interest in working with modern tools & Technologies

- Open-source Java framework experience (Quarkus preferred but Spring is okay)

- Microservices experience

- Terraform experience

- Able to work in a very fast paced environment

- Experience and willingness to be testing your own code


Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

Golang


Job Description:

Our client is looking for Senior Back End Java Engineers to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and documenting the back-end services for their mobile app and website while coaching and mentoring junior resources and collaborating with other team members and stakeholders. You will also drive best practices, ensure the technical feasibility of integrations, and optimize the application for maximum speed, scalability, and reliability. You will investigate and utilize Google Cloud Platform services to continuously improve application architecture and implement microservices using Java and Quarkus framework. You will propose and enhance automation initiatives related to infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting and contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle. This is an established company and environment with a startup feel so you must be able work in a fast-paced environment and used to timelines that are in days instead of weeks. This role is fully remote and long term.


The salary for this position is between 274,517BRL - 329,421.45BRL.


Please apply if you are interested in learning more and we can set up a time to speak further!

title: Systems Engineer (Data Compression)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


What you'll work on

  • Designing and optimizing lossless compression techniques
  • Evaluating compression performance across different datasets
  • Improving throughput, compression ratio, and memory efficiency
  • Benchmarking and profiling performance-critical systems
  • Building high-performance libraries and services
  • Collaborating with engineers to productionize compression technology

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, C, or other systems languages
  • Experience with performance optimization and profiling
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures
  • Experience building high-performance systems or infrastructure
  • Comfortable working with confidential technology under NDA
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with compression algorithms (LZ, Zstd, Huffman, Brotli, etc.)
  • Background in storage systems, distributed systems, or databases
  • Experience working at cloud providers or infrastructure companies
  • Experience with benchmarking or systems performance testing
  • Familiarity with AI / GenAI development tools


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding


UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.


Role Objective


UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.


You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.


Main Responsibilities


1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing


  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).


2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach


  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.


3. Strategy & CRM Excellence


  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.


Candidate Profile & Experience


  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.


Linguistic Versatility:


  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).


  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.


Tech Stack


  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Data Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position and is a PJ contract.


Required Skills & Experience


- 5+ years of experience with Power BI development and engineering (DAX and semantic model development and deployment)

- Strong hands on coding ability in PySpark and Python

- Professional working experience with Databricks and Spark platforms

- Experience working in Microsoft Fabric

- Fair knowledge on the use of Azure Dev Ops (ADO) to manage repository and versions

- Strong communication skills and experience engaging directly with business stakeholders and technical teams


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


- Knowledge of Tabular and ALM tools to work on Semantic Model and automation

- Experience working for a global company/ with a global team


Job Description


A global biopharmaceutical company is seeking strong Data Engineers to join their team to support a portfolio of ongoing clinical operations projects. These individuals will work on a team of Engineers of all levels and will partner with technical and functional partners to meet the project needs. The ideal candidates should and in-depth expertise with Power BI (including DAX and Semantic Model Development), strong PySpark & Python coding experience, and experience with Databricks. Additionally, all senior level resources should have proven working experience with and strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and should have experience with leading junior team members. Strong communication skills are a must along with the proven ability to work with cross functional teams and stakeholders to drive project work and all candidates should be eager to learn new skills. These are immediate, ongoing needs that will go until the end of 2026 and will be extended into 2027. These positions are based in LATAM and candidates are able to sit remotely in any country with similar timezone to US EST.

title: England Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced English Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into English markets, with a strong understanding of English business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with English cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within England's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in English cosmetic packaging markets

Qualifications

- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with English cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of English cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to England as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Vaga para Professor de Alemão (REMOTO)


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professor de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade: Flexibilidade de horário, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio das nossas redes e marketing e parcerias.


  • Experiência e Flexibilidade: Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.


  • Habilidades Tecnológicas: Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.


  • Comunicação: Ter uma boa comunicação, tanto com os alunos quanto com a parte administrativa do Instituto.


Competências


  • Capacidade de conduzir aulas interativas e envolventes, usando diversas ferramentas tecnológicas para otimizar o aprendizado.


  • É fundamental atenção às demandas e necessidades dos alunos em prol de garantir um ensino personalizado e eficaz.


Oferecemos:

Remuneração Competitiva: Uma hora-aula de R$ 40,00 atrativa e alinhada com o mercado, comparável às demais escolas de idiomas.


Suporte ao Professor: Fornecemos todo o suporte necessário, incluindo um convênio Google para utilizações de ferramentes pagas pelo Instituto, materiais didáticos atualizados para facilitar o processo de ensino e um material didático próprio do Instituto.


Ambiente de Trabalho: Um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio, onde valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos professores e incentivamos o aprimoramento constante.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!
