Mandatory Skills Description:


  • Product & Delivery Execution
  • Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
  • Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Experience managing multiple release timelines
  • Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
  • Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities
  • Quality & Compliance Mindset
  • Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
  • Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact
  • Release & Operational Skills
  • Experience coordinating software releases end to end
  • Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
  • Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)
  • Tools & Ways of Working
  • Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Ability to operate independently with limited guidance
  • Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
  • Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
  • Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
  • Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
  • Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Project Description:


  • This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
  • Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
  • Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
  • The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:


  • Product & Backlog Management
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug
  • fixes, improvements, and release work
  • Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance
  • criteria with stakeholder
  • Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
  • Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation
  • Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
  • Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
  • Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
  • Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
  • Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
  • Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
  • Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
  • Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or compliance may be affected
  • Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
  • Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Release & Operational Ownership
  • Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and
  • communication
  • Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
  • Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
  • Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
  • Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for
  • external testers, etc.)
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
  • representatives of legal and regulatory departments
  • Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
  • Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
  • Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
International Assistant Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiter Assistant with strong English skills to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build an international career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$3,500
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM – 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Executive Recruiting, Leadership, Management)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support sourcing and pre-qualification of candidates for U.S. clients
  • Conduct initial screenings via calls, emails, and messages
  • Maintain updated databases (ATS and job boards)
  • Draft and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and candidate–recruiter communication flow
  • Assist with administrative recruitment tasks


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication
  • 3+ months of experience in recruitment
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in Recruitment or Talent Acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Coordenador de Vendas Técnicas - Regional MG | GO | DF
description:
Venha transformar o mundo e acelerar seu sucesso!


É preciso de pessoas extraordinárias para alcançar a grandeza. Pessoas com senso de propósito e integridade. Pessoas com busca incansável pela excelência. Pessoas que se importam em fazer as coisas melhores “Para Aqueles Que Constroem o Mundo”. Parece com você? Junte-se ao nosso time de mais de 50.000 profissionais diversos e de alta performance ao redor do mundo, que estão deixando sua marca em algumas das marcas mais amadas do mundo, incluindo DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET® e HUSTLER®.


A Vaga:


Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Coordenador de Vendas Técnicas focada em nosso portfólio de Ferramentas e Soluções Industriais. Temos duas posições abertas: uma focada no estado de Minas Gerais (MG) e outra para cobertura de Goiás (GO) e Distrito Federal (DF). Esta vaga foca na geração de demanda através de visitas técnicas, homologação de produtos e desenvolvimento de novos mercados. É essencial ter perfil hands-on, orientação para resultados e total disponibilidade para viagens constantes em sua região de atuação.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais constantes em indústrias, projetos e distribuidores na região de atuação (MG ou GO/DF);
  • Apresentar e demonstrar o portfólio industrial da companhia, destacando benefícios técnicos e diferenciais competitivos;
  • Conduzir a homologação de ferramentas, testes de performance e conversão de marcas junto aos usuários finais;
  • Ministrar palestras e treinamentos técnicos para capacitação de parceiros e clientes;
  • Prospectar e desenvolver novos clientes e usuários potenciais no segmento industrial;
  • Acompanhar e atingir os objetivos mensais de vendas e indicadores da área;
  • Emitir relatórios periódicos de visitas e mercado para suporte à tomada de decisão;


Competências e Qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando (mandatório);
  • Total disponibilidade para viagens constantes e atuação em campo (mandatório);
  • Experiência prévia em vendas externas, visitas técnicas industriais e homologação de produtos (mandatório);
  • Conhecimento técnico em ferramentas elétricas, manuais e acessórios (mandatório);
  • Possuir CNH ativa, categoria B (mandatório);
  • Domínio intermediário do Pacote Office (mandatório);
  • Inglês ou Espanhol será considerado um diferencial;
  • Residir ou ter facilidade de deslocamento nas regiões de MG ou GO/DF (mandatório).


E Mais:

title: Analista de DP Pl.
description:
Olá, Cobasilovers!

Você tem paixão por todas as formas de vida, seja ela plantas, animais ou pessoas? Gosta da ideia de ser um mediador de afeto entre elas?

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuar como Analista de DP Pl .

Se você é apaixonado(a) por animais, plantas, pessoas, processos e projetos aqui é o seu lugar!


Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar o cálculo da rescisão de colaboradores no sistema RM labore.
  • Conferir e processar as rescisões e FGTS digital.
  • Gerar e transmitir obrigações como e-social e FGTS digital.
  • Controlar e acompanhar as solicitações de desligamentos.
  • Atender os gestores para esclarecimento de dúvidas.
  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação trabalhista e das normas internas da empresa.
  • Manter o sistema RM labore atualizado, tendo um olhar estratégico para automatizações e melhoria de processos.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na função, com domínio das rotinas de departamento pessoal.
  • Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista.
  • Domínio de sistemas de folha de pagamento RM Labore (diferencial), eSocial e FGTS digital.
  • Pacote Office intermediário (especialmente Excel).
  • Conhecimento em fórmulas de Excel, para conferência dos eventos através de relatórios;


Oferecemos

  • VR/VA no valor de 961,00 reais com flexibilidade de escolha;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Café da manhã com frutas;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica Amil;
  • Day Off;
  • Ambiente Pet Friendly;
  • Cartão Ticket Plus;
  • Wellhub (Convênio com Academias);
  • Wellz (Plataforma online para cuidado, bem estar e saúde mental);
  • Convênio com o Sesc e Senac.


Local de trabalho: Vila Leopoldina - Próximo ao parque Villa Lobos.

title: Especialista em Power Platform
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Power Platform para atuar no desenvolvimento, evolução e sustentação de soluções corporativas baseadas no ecossistema Microsoft 365 , com forte atuação em Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint e Copilot .

Esse(a) profissional será responsável por criar soluções escaláveis, automatizadas e orientadas ao negócio, atuando em conjunto com times técnicos e áreas usuárias.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver soluções utilizando Power Apps (Canvas e Model-driven).
  • Criar e manter fluxos automatizados com Power Automate .
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e customização de soluções em SharePoint Online (desenvolvimento nativo e SPFx ).
  • Integrar soluções da Power Platform com Microsoft 365 e sistemas externos.
  • Apoiar a implementação e uso de Copilot e recursos de IA aplicados aos processos de negócio.
  • Levantar requisitos junto às áreas de negócio e traduzir em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança e governança.
  • Apoiar testes, homologações e documentação das soluções.
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua e otimização de processos digitais.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais

Power Platform e Microsoft 365

  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform .
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de soluções corporativas no ambiente Microsoft .
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio / Microsoft Copilot .
  • Experiência com governança da Power Platform .


SharePoint Online

  • Experiência com SharePoint Online (Administração Central, listas, bibliotecas, permissões, integrações).
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento e customização com SharePoint Online nativo e SPFx .


Integrações e Boas Práticas

  • Experiência com integrações via APIs e conectores .
  • Conhecimento em controle de versões , gestão de ambientes (Dev, Homologação e Produção ) e boas práticas.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva junto ao negócio.


Diferenciais (Desejável)

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas do Microsoft 365 , como:
  • Teams
  • Outlook
  • Planner
  • OneDrive
  • Noções de Azure (Functions, Logic Apps, Azure AD).
  • Certificações Microsoft relacionadas à Power Platform .
  • Conhecimento no desenvolvimento de outras tecnologias (.Net ).


Informações Adicionais

  • Contrato: PJ
  • Remuneração: mensal fixa
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Benefícios

  • Notebook (caso necessário)
  • Descanso remunerado de 14 dias
  • Total Pass
  • Convênio para compra de medicamentos com desconto em folha
  • Descontos em cursos de graduação, certificações e MBA

title: Recruiter
description:
About the company:

Our client is a marketing and creative agency dedicated to enhancing brand visibility and impact. They specialize in integrating sales and marketing with measurable strategies that foster strong brand experiences. Their comprehensive approach spans from discovery and evaluation to execution, driving both creative engagement and business growth.


Job Description:

Our client is seeking experienced recruiters to join their team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in recruiting, excellent communication skills in English, and a proactive mindset.


Responsibilities of the role:

• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing candidates to onboarding. • Utilize ATS and CRM tools to track and manage candidate information. • Collaborate with team members to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies. • Conduct interviews and assess candidate qualifications. • Maintain strong relationships with potential candidates and clients.


Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in recruitment. • Proficient in written and verbal English. • Experience with ATS and CRM systems. • Proven track record of managing the full recruitment cycle.


Preferred Skills:

• Strong organizational and time management skills. • Ability to work independently and proactively. • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.


Personality:

• Proactive and detail-oriented. • Strong problem-solving skills. • Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment.


Software & Tools

• Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) • Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools


English Level:

C1, C2.


Schedule:

9-5 EST

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Enterprise Account Manager — HR Technology (LATAM)
description:
About Cadient


Cadient Talent is an AI-enabled hiring platform helping large employers attract, hire, and retain hourly and distributed workforces at scale. Our platform combines ATS technology, automation, and AI-driven recruiting workflows to help organizations:

  • Reduce time-to-hire
  • Increase applicant conversion
  • Improve hiring outcomes for high-volume workforces


Cadient serves enterprise employers across industries including healthcare, hospitality, retail, and service businesses. We are building the next generation of AI-powered hiring infrastructure used by some of the largest hiring organizations in the United States.


The Role

We are hiring an Enterprise Account Manager based in Latin America to manage and grow relationships with US-based enterprise clients. You will act as the primary relationship owner for HR and Talent Acquisition leaders, ensuring they achieve measurable hiring results using the Cadient platform. This role is responsible for client retention, revenue expansion, and strategic account management. You will operate as a trusted advisor, helping clients optimize hiring performance while identifying opportunities to expand their use of Cadient solutions.


Key Responsibilities


Own Client Relationships

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customer accounts in the United States
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for HR and talent acquisition leaders
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) analyzing hiring performance and platform usage
  • Ensure strong platform adoption, satisfaction, and measurable outcomes
  • Monitor client health signals and proactively resolve risks


Drive Revenue Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to expand platform usage and services
  • Drive renewals, upsells, and cross-sells
  • Build expansion pipelines within existing accounts
  • Work closely with sales leadership on strategic account growth


Coordinate Across Teams

  • Partner with product, support, and implementation teams
  • Ensure issues are resolved quickly and professionally
  • Bring customer insights back to internal teams to improve product and service delivery


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 3–6 years experience in account management, customer success, or SaaS client management
  • Experience working with US-based customers
  • Fluent English communication skills
  • Strong ability to manage multiple client relationships simultaneously
  • Comfortable discussing business outcomes, ROI, and performance metrics
  • Experience working remotely across US time zones


Preferred

  • Experience in HR technology, SaaS, or recruiting platforms
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Workday, iCIMS, UKG, Paradox, or similar
  • Experience working with enterprise HR or talent acquisition teams
  • Experience supporting high-volume hiring industries
  • Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.


What Success Looks Like

  • High client retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Strong platform adoption and client satisfaction
  • Consistent upsell and expansion opportunities
  • Clear communication of account risks and opportunities
  • Strong internal collaboration with sales, product, and support teams


What You'll Be Responsible For in the First 90 Days

  • Build relationships with 20–40 active US client accounts
  • Conduct your first client performance and strategy reviews
  • Identify 3–5 expansion opportunities within existing accounts
  • Develop strong working relationships with internal product and support teams
  • Gain deep familiarity with Cadient’s hiring platform and workflows


This Role Is NOT a Fit If

  • You are looking for an entry-level customer support role
  • You are uncomfortable owning revenue retention and upsells
  • You prefer task execution instead of client-facing strategy
  • You are not comfortable speaking directly with US enterprise clients in English


Why Join Cadient

  • Work with a growing HR technology company serving large US employers
  • Be part of the AI transformation of hiring
  • Fully remote role based in Latin America
  • Exposure to enterprise HR leaders and large-scale hiring operations
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based upside


Application Note

When applying, please include a short paragraph answering the following question:

What is one thing most SaaS companies do wrong in customer success?


Applications without this answer may not be considered!

title: React/Retool Developer
description:
My US client is looking to expand their development team in Brazil. They are seeking a React Developer to work on their CMS solution. They are looking for a motivated developer with solid React experience and basic SQL skills to build and maintain internal tools using Retool. This role requires someone who can work independently, solve problems effectively, and communicate clearly in English.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain internal applications using Retool and React.
  • Write and optimize basic SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
  • Perform simple data extraction and analysis from relational databases.
  • Collaborate with product and technical stakeholders to understand requirements.
  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and propose effective solutions.
  • Deliver features with minimal supervision and manage tasks independently.
  • Maintain clean, readable, and maintainable code.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Solid experience with React (components, hooks, state management).
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL databases:
  • Writing queries (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY)
  • Creating simple functions and procedures
  • Performing data extraction
  • Ability to work independently with limited assistance.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable.
  • Proficient English communication skills (written and verbal).


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience with Retool or other low-code/internal tools platforms.
  • Experience working with APIs (REST).
  • Familiarity with Git and basic development workflows.
  • Experience working with internal business tools or dashboards.


This role is CLT and remote in Brazil. Target compenstation is R$10,000 per month

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
Global Executive Recrutier - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM – 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience with Hunting in the North-American Market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus


Nice to Have

  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

Project Description:

  • Join a team building enterprise-scale headend applications for a leading video content provider. You will design and implement microservices and AWS-based solutions within a Kubernetes environment.

- Architect and develop backend microservices using Java and Golang.

- Kubernetes deployment and orchestration expertise.

- Skilled in software/system design for scalability and fault tolerance.

- Experience with CI/CD environments and tools.

- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

title: Oracle EBS Developer
description:
Job Title: Technical Consultant – Oracle EBS R12 (FRICEW)

Job Type- Contract

Location- Remote 100%

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Technical Consultant with strong hands-on experience in Oracle E-Business Suite R12. The candidate should have solid experience working on FRICEW components (Forms, Reports, Integrations, Conversions, Enhancements, Workflow) and strong PL/SQL skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and customize Oracle EBS R12 objects.
  • Work on FRICEW components:
  • Forms customization
  • Reports (XML/BI Publisher, Oracle Reports)
  • Integrations (inbound & outbound interfaces)
  • Data conversions
  • Enhancements
  • Workflow development
  • Develop and support PL/SQL packages, procedures, and triggers.
  • Create and maintain technical design documents (TDD).
  • Work closely with functional consultants and business users.
  • Support testing, deployment, and production issues.


Required Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in Oracle EBS R12.
  • Strong experience in FRICEW development.
  • Excellent PL/SQL and SQL knowledge.
  • Experience with XML Publisher / BI Publisher.
  • Knowledge of APIs, Interface Tables, and Concurrent Programs.
  • Experience in Workflow customization.
  • Basic Unix shell scripting knowledge.


Preferred Skills

  • Implementation or upgrade project experience.
  • Knowledge of Finance or SCM modules.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Business Performance Analyst
description:
We are hiring!


Please find the job description below. If you're interested, I would appreciate it if you could share your updated resume with me.


Role: Principal Business Performance Analyst

Location: LATAM - Remote

Type: Contract

Job Description:

We are seeking a Principal Business Performance Analyst to drive personalization and affiliate marketing analytics within our Marketing Technology team. This role focuses on turning complex data into actionable insights that improve user experience, conversions, and recurring revenue.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze the impact of personalization initiatives on key user and business metrics
  • Deliver actionable insights from affiliate performance data to drive conversion and revenue growth
  • Lead A/B and multivariate testing to optimize affiliate offers, landing pages, and user journeys
  • Develop customer segmentation and attribution models to evaluate campaign effectiveness
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau, Data Studio, or similar tools
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Tech teams to improve funnel performance and affiliate strategy


Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced analytics using Python or R
  • Experience with A/B testing, personalization, and experimentation
  • Hands-on experience with affiliate marketing analytics
  • Expertise with data platforms such as BigQuery, AWS Athena, or AWS Glue
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: SDR/BDR – Soluções em Tecnologia e Cibersegurança
description:
O Grupo Ivy é um ecossistema completo de soluções de Tecnologia e Cibersegurança, atuando com projetos de alta complexidade, consultoria especializada, Outsourcing, SRE, desenvolvimento de software e um portfólio robusto de serviços em segurança digital, além de uma operação estruturada de revendas e distribuição de soluções corporativas.


Nossa unidade de cibersegurança entrega serviços como Pentest, Pentest Contínuo, Security Champion, Threat Modeling, Treinamentos, Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Governança, incluindo produtos proprietários voltados à evolução contínua da maturidade em segurança, soluções orientadas a risco, escaláveis e integradas aos desafios reais dos ambientes modernos.


Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um SDR/BDR para atuar na linha de frente comercial, responsável por gerar oportunidades qualificadas, realizar o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes e construir relacionamentos sólidos com decisores de tecnologia e segurança.

A pessoa ideal tem excelente comunicação, capacidade investigativa, boa desenvoltura ao telefone e experiência comercial no mercado Tech ou Cyber.

Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remoto, com possíveis visitas presenciais a clientes quando necessário.
  • Formato de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção ativa (principalmente por telefone).
  • Conduzir o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes, apresentando a Ivy e entendendo o cenário atual.
  • Qualificar leads avaliando necessidades, dores, maturidade e momento de compra.
  • Manter rotina de acompanhamento e follow-up com leads em diferentes estágios.
  • Registrar informações no CRM, garantindo organização e clareza para o time de vendas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time comercial para priorização de contas e evolução do pipeline.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales, Pré-vendas ou função semelhante em empresas de tecnologia ou cibersegurança.
  • Boa comunicação verbal, especialmente para conversas por telefone.
  • Capacidade de investigação, escuta ativa e entendimento de problemas de tecnologia.
  • Organização para gerenciar conversas, prioridades e registros.
  • Facilidade em criar e manter relacionamentos profissionais.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em consultorias de tecnologia ou segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento geral do mercado de TI ou Cyber (infraestrutura, projetos, serviços, governança, segurança).
  • Experiência em vendas B2B.

Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Organização e consistência
  • Autonomia e proatividade

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer - Palantir, Palantir Foundry, AIP

Location: Remote

Contract: 6 months initial


We are looking for a skilled Forward Deployed Engineer with expertise in Palantir technologies, including Palantir Foundry, Ontology, and AIP. The ideal candidate will possess strong programming skills in Python and SQL to build and deploy data solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Solution Development: Design, build, and implement data integration and analysis solutions using Palantir Foundry and Ontology tailored to customer requirements.
  • Data Management: Utilize AIP for seamless integration of diverse data sources, ensuring effective data flow and management.
  • Programming: Develop and optimize data queries and scripts using Python and SQL to enhance system functionality and performance.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with clients to understand their business challenges and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • User Support: Provide training and support to end-users, enabling them to fully leverage the tools and systems deployed.
  • Best Practices: Advocate for and implement best practices in data analysis, system design, and software development.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience with Palantir Foundry, Ontology, and AIP systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience in working with enterprise systems and data integration solutions.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Skills:

  • Prior experience in a client-facing role or deployment environment.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools or frameworks.
  • Knowledge of machine learning concepts is a plus.

title: Back End Developer
description:
About the company:

Our client is a dynamic startup focused on building a unique video reaction messaging app for iOS.


Job Description:

Our client is seeking a full-time Backend Developer experienced in Node.js, particularly with the NestJS framework. The ideal candidate will manage backend services, integrate AWS, and implement a subscription model. This role involves optimizing the app for scaling and cost-effectiveness while collaborating with the team to enhance functionality based on user feedback.


Responsibilities of the role:

• Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js and NestJS.

• Integrate and manage AWS services to support app functionalities.

• Implement a subscription model for the app.

• Optimize the app for scaling and cost-efficiency.

• Collaborate with the team to analyze metrics and inform feature changes.

• Contribute to the overall development strategy and improvement of the app.


Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 3 to 5 years of experience in backend development.

• Proficiency in Node.js, specifically with NestJS.

• Experience with AWS services.

• Familiarity with WebSockets for real-time messaging.

• Strong analytical skills for cloud and metric analysis.

• Excellent English communication skills.


Preferred Skills:

• Understanding of full-stack development concepts.

• Experience with performance tracking software.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work in a startup environment.

• Flexibility to assist with occasional non-development tasks.


Personality:

• Self-driven and hardworking.

• Passionate about technology and startups.

• Open-minded and collaborative.

• Strong team player with good interpersonal skills.


Software & Tools

• Node.js, NestJS

• AWS services

• WebSockets for real-time communication


English Level:

C1, C2.


Schedule:

9 to 5 EST

title: Linux/Cloud System Administrator
description:
Your role and responsibilities:


Lead L2/L3 production and project support for Linux environments

Manage installations, patching, migrations, and scripting (Shell & Perl)

Troubleshoot hardware/software issues across Linux(SUSE/RHEL)

Optimize system performance and availability

Coach and mentor team members

Work with ITIL-based tools and monitoring systems


Requirements and Qualifications:


Hands-on experience in Linux systems with Pacemaker cluster

Deep expertise in filesystem, volume, and storage management

Strong knowledge of networking, clustering (PCS), and system hardening

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

Azure/AWS/GCP(IAAS)

Deploying Virtual machine and Creating, managing internal & external load balancers to allow the public network communication with specific ports.

Configuring VNET & VWAN peering between different networks to allow communication.

Used network security groups, subnets, route tables, local network gateway and application security groups to ensure security for customer networks.



Bonus Points:


Linux certification

Advanced English

Experience with Pacemaker Cluster, DNS, DHCP, LDAP


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required
  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Analista de contas a pagar
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Oportunidade de carreira em VEOLINK como Analista de Contas a Pagar. Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e meticuloso para se juntar à nossa equipe como Analista de Contas a Pagar. Localizada na Vila Leopoldina, nossa empresa busca alguém que tenha uma forte visão detalhada e excelentes habilidades de organização para gerenciar nossas atividades financeiras.


Sobre o Papel


Como Analista de Contas a Pagar, você será responsável por garantir que todas as transações de saída sejam processadas de forma precisa e oportuna. Seu papel será fundamental para manter a integridade financeira da empresa e garantir que todas as faturas, notas fiscais e pagamentos sejam tratados corretamente e em tempo hábil.


Responsabilidades


  • Colaborar estreitamente com outras equipes para garantir que os processos de pagamento sejam eficientes.
  • Garantir que as obrigações financeiras sejam cumpridas.
  • Revisar e validar as informações financeiras.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as políticas da empresa.
  • Colaborar na preparação de relatórios financeiros.


Qualificações


  • Experiência em contabilidade ou áreas afins é essencial.
  • Sólido conhecimento em sistemas de gestão financeira.


Habilidades Necessárias


  • Habilidades de comunicação.
  • Habilidades de organização.


Habilidades Preferenciais


  • Imprescindível conhecimento com Protheus.


Benefícios: VR R$ 35,00 dia, Seguro de vida, Assistência médica e odontológica Bradesco, VT, TotalPass

Horário de segunda a sexta das 08:00 às 17:48
